description: DEF CON 33 Data Duplication Village explores data replication protocols, large-scale storage telemetry, decentralized storage abuse, and hardware reliability metrics across modern storage systems.

talks.title: Fungible Threats
talks.teaser: Demonstrates how adversaries abuse distributed data replication systems, IPFS, NFTs, and Cloudflare R2 for resilient C2 infrastructure and payload delivery.
talks.summary:
Abusing Distributed Data Replication for Malware Infrastructure

Distributed data storage and content delivery networks provide high redundancy and censorship resistance, but these same architectural traits offer adversaries resilient channels for command-and-control (C2) and malicious payload distribution.

Adversary Tradecraft Across IPFS, NFTs, and Cloudflare R2

Mauro Eldritch and Nelson Colon demonstrate how threat actors leverage InterPlanetary File System (IPFS) nodes, NFT metadata, Codex, and Cloudflare R2 object storage to host un-takedownable C2 channels, second-stage droppers, and dynamic phishing landing pages.

Evading Infrastructure Takedowns and Blocking

Traditional domain-based indicators of compromise (IOCs) fail against decentralized storage protocols where cryptographic content hashes replace fixed IP addresses, requiring defensive teams to adapt threat-hunting playbooks.

talks.title: Tracking 300K+ Drives: Modernizing Backblaze Drive Stats
talks.teaser: Backblaze engineers share backend architecture modernizations and updated Annualized Failure Rate (AFR) reliability trends across 300,000+ data center drives.
talks.summary:
The History and Scope of Backblaze Drive Stats

Since 2013, the Backblaze Drive Stats project has published open datasets tracking the operational reliability, lifetime telemetry, and failure metrics of hundreds of thousands of enterprise hard disk drives and solid-state drives.

Modernizing the Data Analytics Pipeline

Stephanie and Pat discuss recent data warehouse modernizations, migrating legacy backend systems to Snowflake with Trino and Apache Iceberg to scale real-time telemetry processing and automated failure validation across 300,000+ active drives.

Analyzing Annualized Failure Rates and SSD Metrics

Updated Annualized Failure Rate (AFR) trends highlight reliability differences across drive manufacturers, storage capacities, and workloads, while addressing the unique wear and telemetry challenges of data-center SSDs.

Operational Takeaways for Storage Reliability

Sharing longitudinal hardware failure data provides storage architects and datacenter operators with actionable benchmarks to optimize storage topology, drive replacement cycles, and backup redundancy.
